summary.text: Ricky Rivard is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 65 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Dan Ugaste (R).
Rivard is an adjunct professor and real estate agent who says affordability is the central issue in the race.

paragraphs.text: Rivard graduated from Saint Charles High School and earned a graduate degree from Northern Illinois University in 2018.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he holds a master's degree in political science from Northern Illinois University and has spent more than 20 years working as a real estate agent, an adjunct professor and in the service industry.
Rivard won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary without opposition.
In the survey he said his campaign focuses on lowering health care and childcare costs, property tax relief through changes to how the state funds schools, and attainable housing.
